title.zh: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
title.en: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients

current_state.zh: Standard Chartered launched direct Bitcoin and Ethereum trading for its affluent UAE clients after receiving a Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority license in Dubai, offering buy/sell, custody and settlement through existing bank accounts in a closed-loop model built with Zodia Markets.
current_state.en: Standard Chartered launched direct Bitcoin and Ethereum trading for its affluent UAE clients after receiving a Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority license in Dubai, offering buy/sell, custody and settlement through existing bank accounts in a closed-loop model built with Zodia Markets.
